findings.title: resolveWriters test does not exercise author-date ordering
findings.disposition_rationale: git log --first-parent walks the parent chain, so the nearer commit wins whatever its author date; the test sets an older author date on the nearer commit and asserts it is chosen, which a date-ordered implementation would fail.

findings.title: binding uses the oldest adding commit, so a shared run dir can falsely unbind a per-PR anchor
findings.disposition_rationale: The oldest-first-parent-adding-commit definition is the spec's; per-PR anchors land in their own issue's squash merge. A false unbind only fails closed (the run does not qualify) and is reported in unbound_anchors.

findings.title: unbound anchors do not gate readiness
findings.disposition_rationale: An unbound anchor can never make a run qualifying or a writer-proof file observed, and it still counts as a warning if it fails, so a fabricated anchor outside the reviewed PR contributes nothing to the criterion.

findings.title: dangling-symlink anchors root falls back to the unresolved path
findings.disposition_rationale: resolveAnchorsRoot now exits 2 when the root exists but does not resolve; covered by the dangling-root case in the readiness test.

findings.title: symlink inside the anchors root passes the clean-tree check
findings.disposition_rationale: deriveAnchorDirs drops a symlink-escaping anchor dir and the drop blocks readiness, so the symlink cannot produce a ready report; covered by the symlink-escape test.
